g.text: Core-only project · private stdio MCP · one runtime per graph directory
Runtime ownership · serialized reads / mutations · journal rollback and startup recovery
Atomic file publication · input roots and limits · shared embedding deadline / concurrency limit
Optional Neo4j / Qdrant exports are snapshots, not the retrieval backend.
No supply-chain features. No extra database containers. Model weights stay outside the application image.
All operation paths use the local stores as required; vertical arrows indicate layer access, not exclusive store ownership.
